stem: Which diagram shows the relative position of Earth's axis at the beginning of summer in Texas?

options.label: A
options.text: Diagram with Sun left, Earth on the right with axis tilted toward Sun

options.label: B
options.text: Diagram with Sun bottom center, Earth above Sun with axis vertical

options.label: C
options.text: Diagram with Sun right, Earth left with axis tilted away from Sun

options.label: D
options.text: Diagram with Sun top center, Earth below Sun with axis vertical

visual_elements: Four diagrams each showing the Sun and Earth with Earth's axis orientation labeled A, B, C, D
